title: TypeCraft
tagline: A minimal, distraction-free typing speed test tool built for focus and practice.
shortDescription: Clean typing speed test application designed to measure and improve typing performance without unnecessary distractions.
description: Clean typing speed test application designed to measure and improve typing performance without unnecessary distractions.

caseStudy.problem: Build a typing-test application that behaves correctly at character level without external typing libraries.
caseStudy.solution: Implement typing engine from first principles with React state, timer lifecycle, and keyboard event handling.
features: Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty modes
Correct, incorrect, extra, and missed character handling
Raw WPM and Net WPM calculations
